title: The Past and Present Lives of a Dog

series.title: The Past and Present Lives of a Dog

fullText.simplified:
七、你别跑

    米乐看着这些照片，他好想回家，好担心季南。
    “米乐，来世你也一定会有一个好主人，爱你，和你一起玩，一起长大。跟过去的生活说再见，然后喝汤吧！”孟婆又把那碗汤放在了米乐的前面。
    米乐没有说话，他看看孟婆，看看眼前的汤，又看看桥的那边。突然，米乐开始飞快地向前跑去，他从孟婆的身边跑过，他从人们的腿边跑过。虽然他只能去来世，但是他不要喝汤，不要忘记季南。他要去来世找季南。季南一定是健健康康的，季南一定还能跟他一起玩。还有阿晴，还有他们的家，他要回去！他必须回去！没有人可以让他停下来！
    “你别跑！米乐！米乐！！”孟婆在后面叫着他。
    虽然米乐知道孟婆在叫他，但是他头也不回，一直飞快地跑着。
    “米乐！关门，把桥那边的大门关上！”孟婆大声地说着。
    米乐看见眼前的大门在慢慢关上，他努力地向前跑着，就在大门马上要关上的时候，米乐向前一跳，然后他觉得眼前都是白色的，他看不见前面的东西了……
    慢慢地，他听见自己的身边有很多狗的声音。慢慢地，他看见眼前有很多只小狗。他们太小了，真可爱！他们有黑黑的小眼睛，黑黑的小鼻子，短短的小腿。米乐想摸摸他们，米乐把脚放在他们的身上。突然，米乐发现自己的脚也这么小！米乐看看自己的腿，这么短！米乐看看自己的尾巴，尾巴呢？不见了！这太奇怪了！对了，孟婆说他会重新出生。所以现在他……才出生？他和眼前的小狗一样大？！我的天！今生的米乐是一只小柯基！
fullText.traditional:
七、你別跑

    米樂看著這些照片，他好想回家，好擔心季南。
    “米樂，來世你也一定會有一個好主人，愛你，和你一起玩，一起長大。跟過去的生活說再見，然後喝湯吧！”孟婆又把那碗湯放在了米樂的前面。
    米樂沒有說話，他看看孟婆，看看眼前的湯，又看看橋的那邊。突然，米樂開始飛快地向前跑去，他從孟婆的身邊跑過，他從人們的腿邊跑過。雖然他只能去來世，但是他不要喝湯，不要忘記季南。他要去來世找季南。季南一定是健健康康的，季南一定還能跟他一起玩。還有阿晴，還有他們的家，他要回去！他必須回去！沒有人可以讓他停下來！
    “你別跑！米樂！米樂！！”孟婆在後面叫著他。
    雖然米樂知道孟婆在叫他，但是他頭也不回，一直飛快地跑著。
    “米樂！關門，把橋那邊的大門關上！”孟婆大聲地說著。
    米樂看見眼前的大門在慢慢關上，他努力地向前跑著，就在大門馬上要關上的時候，米樂向前一跳，然後他覺得眼前都是白色的，他看不見前面的東西了……
    慢慢地，他聽見自己的身邊有很多狗的聲音。慢慢地，他看見眼前有很多隻小狗。他們太小了，真可愛！他們有黑黑的小眼睛，黑黑的小鼻子，短短的小腿。米樂想摸摸他們，米樂把腳放在他們的身上。突然，米樂發現自己的腳也這麼小！米樂看看自己的腿，這麼短！米樂看看自己的尾巴，尾巴呢？不見了！這太奇怪了！對了，孟婆說他會重新出生。所以現在他……才出生？他和眼前的小狗一樣大？！我的天！今生的米樂是一隻小柯基！

sentences.english: Mi Le looked at these pictures. He really wanted to go home. He was so worried about Ji Nan.

sentences.traditional: “米樂，來世你也一定會有一個好主人，愛你，和你一起玩，一起長大。

sentences.english: “Mi Le, in the next life, you will also have a good owner who will love you, play with you, and grow up with you.

sentences.english: Say goodbye to the past and drink some soup!” Meng Po put the bowl of soup in front of Mi Le again.

sentences.english: Mi Le said nothing. He looked at Meng Po, looked at the soup in front of him, and then looked at the other side of the bridge.

sentences.traditional: 突然，米樂開始飛快地向前跑去，他從孟婆的身邊跑過，他從人們的腿邊跑過。

sentences.english: Suddenly, Mi Le began to run at lightning speed. He ran past Meng Po. He ran past people’s legs.

sentences.simplified: 虽然他只能去来世，但是他不要喝汤，不要忘记季南。
sentences.traditional: 雖然他只能去來世，但是他不要喝湯，不要忘記季南。

sentences.english: Although he had to go on to the next life, he didn’t want to drink the soup and forget Ji Nan.

sentences.simplified: 他要去来世找季南。季南一定是健健康康的，季南一定还能跟他一起玩。
sentences.traditional: 他要去來世找季南。季南一定是健健康康的，季南一定還能跟他一起玩。

sentences.english: He was going to the next life to find Ji Nan. Ji Nan must be in good health. Ji Nan can definitely still play with him.

sentences.traditional: 還有阿晴，還有他們的家，他要回去！他必須回去！沒有人可以讓他停下來！

sentences.english: There was also A Qing and their home. He had to go back! He had to go back! No one could stop him!

sentences.simplified: “你别跑！米乐！米乐！！”孟婆在后面叫着他。
sentences.traditional: “你別跑！米樂！米樂！！”孟婆在後面叫著他。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ bié pǎo mǐ lè mǐ lè mèng pó zài hòu miàn jiào zhe tā
sentences.english: “Don’t run! Mi Le! Mi Le!” Meng Po called out to him from behind.

sentences.simplified: 虽然米乐知道孟婆在叫他，但是他头也不回，一直飞快地跑着。
sentences.traditional: 雖然米樂知道孟婆在叫他，但是他頭也不回，一直飛快地跑著。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán mǐ lè zhī dào mèng pó zài jiào tā dàn shì tā tóu yě bù huí yì zhí fēi kuài de pǎo zhe
sentences.english: Although Mi Le knew that Meng Po was calling out to him, he didn’t turn around. He kept running at lightning speed.

sentences.simplified: “米乐！关门，把桥那边的大门关上！”孟婆大声地说着。
sentences.traditional: “米樂！關門，把橋那邊的大門關上！”孟婆大聲地說著。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè guān mén bǎ qiáo nà bian de dà mén guān shàng mèng pó dà shēng de shuō zhe
sentences.english: “Mi Le! Close the gate, close the gate on the other side of the bridge!” Meng Po said loudly.

sentences.simplified: 米乐看见眼前的大门在慢慢关上，他努力地向前跑着，
sentences.traditional: 米樂看見眼前的大門在慢慢關上，他努力地向前跑著，

sentences.english: Mi Le saw the gate in front of him slowly closing, and he ran forward with great effort.

sentences.simplified: 就在大门马上要关上的时候，米乐向前一跳，
sentences.traditional: 就在大門馬上要關上的時候，米樂向前一跳，
sentences.pinyin: jiù zài dà mén mǎ shàng yào guān shàng de shí hou mǐ lè xiàng qián yí tiào
sentences.english: Just as the gate was about to close, Mi Le jumped forward.

sentences.simplified: 然后他觉得眼前都是白色的，他看不见前面的东西了……
sentences.traditional: 然後他覺得眼前都是白色的，他看不見前面的東西了……
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu tā jué de yǎn qián dōu shì bái sè de tā kàn bú jiàn qián miàn de dōng xi le
sentences.english: Then he felt like everything in front of him was white. He couldn’t see what was in front of him …

sentences.simplified: 慢慢地，他听见自己的身边有很多狗的声音。
sentences.traditional: 慢慢地，他聽見自己的身邊有很多狗的聲音。
sentences.pinyin: màn man de tā tīng jiàn zì jǐ de shēn biān yǒu hěn duō gǒu de shēng yīn
sentences.english: Slowly, he heard the sound of many dogs around him.

sentences.simplified: 慢慢地，他看见眼前有很多只小狗。他们太小了，真可爱！
sentences.traditional: 慢慢地，他看見眼前有很多隻小狗。他們太小了，真可愛！
sentences.pinyin: màn man de tā kàn jiàn yǎn qián yǒu hěn duō zhī xiǎo gǒu tā men tài xiǎo le zhēn kě ài
sentences.english: Slowly, he saw a lot of puppies in front of him. They were so tiny and really cute!

sentences.simplified: 他们有黑黑的小眼睛，黑黑的小鼻子，短短的小腿。米乐想摸摸他们，米乐把脚放在他们的身上。
sentences.traditional: 他們有黑黑的小眼睛，黑黑的小鼻子，短短的小腿。米樂想摸摸他們，米樂把腳放在他們的身上。
sentences.pinyin: tā men yǒu hēi hēi de xiǎo yǎn jing hēi hēi de xiǎo bí zi duǎn duǎn de xiǎo tuǐ mǐ lè xiǎng mō mō tā men mǐ lè bǎ jiǎo fàng zài tā men de shēn shang
sentences.english: They had dark little eyes, dark little noses, and short little legs. Mi Le wanted to stroke them, so he put his paw on them.

sentences.simplified: 突然，米乐发现自己的脚也这么小！米乐看看自己的腿，这么短！
sentences.traditional: 突然，米樂發現自己的腳也這麼小！米樂看看自己的腿，這麼短！
sentences.pinyin: tū rán mǐ lè fā xiàn zì jǐ de jiǎo yě zhè me xiǎo mǐ lè kàn kan zì jǐ de tuǐ zhè me duǎn
sentences.english: Suddenly, Mi Le realized his paw was really small too! Mi Le looked at his own legs. They were so short!

sentences.simplified: 米乐看看自己的尾巴，尾巴呢？不见了！这太奇怪了！
sentences.traditional: 米樂看看自己的尾巴，尾巴呢？不見了！這太奇怪了！
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè kàn kan zì jǐ de wěi ba wěi ba ne bú jiàn le zhè tài qí guài le
sentences.english: Mi Le looked for his tail. Where was his tail? It had gone! This was so strange!

sentences.simplified: 对了，孟婆说他会重新出生。所以现在他……才出生？
sentences.traditional: 對了，孟婆說他會重新出生。所以現在他……才出生？
sentences.pinyin: duì le mèng pó shuō tā huì chóng xīn chū shēng suǒ yǐ xiàn zài tā cái chū shēng
sentences.english: Oh, that’s right, Meng Po said he would be reborn. So now he … had just been born?

sentences.simplified: 他和眼前的小狗一样大？！我的天！今生的米乐是一只小柯基！
sentences.traditional: 他和眼前的小狗一樣大？！我的天！今生的米樂是一隻小柯基！
sentences.pinyin: tā hé yǎn qián de xiǎo gǒu yí yàng dà wǒ de tiān jīn shēng de mǐ lè shì yì zhī xiǎo kē jī
sentences.english: He was the same age as the puppies in front of him?! My goodness! In this life, Mi Le was a small corgi!

sentence_translations: (7) Don’t Run
Mi Le looked at these pictures. He really wanted to go home. He was so worried about Ji Nan.
“Mi Le, in the next life, you will also have a good owner who will love you, play with you, and grow up with you.
Say goodbye to the past and drink some soup!” Meng Po put the bowl of soup in front of Mi Le again.
Mi Le said nothing. He looked at Meng Po, looked at the soup in front of him, and then looked at the other side of the bridge.
Suddenly, Mi Le began to run at lightning speed. He ran past Meng Po. He ran past people’s legs.
Although he had to go on to the next life, he didn’t want to drink the soup and forget Ji Nan.
He was going to the next life to find Ji Nan. Ji Nan must be in good health. Ji Nan can definitely still play with him.
There was also A Qing and their home. He had to go back! He had to go back! No one could stop him!
“Don’t run! Mi Le! Mi Le!” Meng Po called out to him from behind.
Although Mi Le knew that Meng Po was calling out to him, he didn’t turn around. He kept running at lightning speed.
“Mi Le! Close the gate, close the gate on the other side of the bridge!” Meng Po said loudly.
Mi Le saw the gate in front of him slowly closing, and he ran forward with great effort.
Just as the gate was about to close, Mi Le jumped forward.
Then he felt like everything in front of him was white. He couldn’t see what was in front of him …
Slowly, he heard the sound of many dogs around him.
Slowly, he saw a lot of puppies in front of him. They were so tiny and really cute!
They had dark little eyes, dark little noses, and short little legs. Mi Le wanted to stroke them, so he put his paw on them.
Suddenly, Mi Le realized his paw was really small too! Mi Le looked at his own legs. They were so short!
Mi Le looked for his tail. Where was his tail? It had gone! This was so strange!
Oh, that’s right, Meng Po said he would be reborn. So now he … had just been born?
He was the same age as the puppies in front of him?! My goodness! In this life, Mi Le was a small corgi!
